Depth Anything V2 Small integration

Source: https://github.com/DepthAnything/Depth-Anything-V2

License: Apache License, Version 2.0
Original license: app/licenses/Depth-Anything-V2-Apache-2.0.txt

Original DINOv2 copyright notices for Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates,
and upstream reference notices remain in the source files.

Local modifications (2026-11-13):
- dpt.py: replace torchvision.transforms.Compose with a small sequential
  callable adapter, so the existing PyTorch runtime needs no torchvision.
- dinov2_layers/attention.py: use PyTorch scaled_dot_product_attention in
  the ordinary attention path to avoid large explicit attention matrices.
- PortraitLab's separate lighting_worker.py handles explicit device selection,
  image normalization, a bounded inference resolution, fixed-weight checks,
  and derived normals. It does not use the upstream auto-device infer_image.

Only the Small model weights are selected, with a separately pinned official
Hugging Face revision and SHA-256 in models/lighting-manifest.json.
The upstream Base, Large and Giant model licenses differ; they are not used.
